idea-plugin.name: Muya Markdown Editor
idea-plugin.description:
A WYSIWYG Markdown editor for IntelliJ-based IDEs. Markdown files open in a JCEF-hosted Muya editor instead of the plain text editor: live WYSIWYG editing and preview, Markdown outline in the structure view, image preview, optional source line numbers, remembered scroll position per file, smooth wheel scrolling, and configurable editor background color or image.

面向 JetBrains 系列 IDE 的所见即所得 Markdown 编辑器。Markdown 文件会在 JCEF 托管的 Muya 编辑器中打开，而不是纯文本编辑器：实时所见即所得编辑与预览、结构视图中的 Markdown 大纲、图片预览、可选的源码行号、按文件记住滚动位置、平滑滚轮滚动，以及可配置的编辑器背景色或背景图。

This plugin is developed on top of the open-source MarkText project, reusing its Muya editor engine and bundling it into a JetBrains plugin.

本插件基于开源项目 MarkText 二次开发，复用其 Muya 编辑器引擎，并打包为 JetBrains 插件。

Acknowledgements / 致谢

Thanks to the MarkText project and its contributors for creating and maintaining MarkText and the Muya editor engine that this plugin builds upon. This is an independent community plugin project and is not an official MarkText project.

感谢 MarkText 项目及其贡献者创建并持续维护 MarkText 与 Muya 编辑器引擎，本插件在此基础上构建。本项目是独立的社区插件项目，并非 MarkText 官方项目。

Project home / 项目主页: https://github.com/Cyber0xFE/marktext-jetbrains
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.1

  • Selection sync: Muya selections are mirrored into a shadow editor's SelectionModel and exposed as a TextEditor, so AI assistant plugins that rely on IDE selections and Search Everywhere can read the selected text.
    选中文本同步：Muya 选区写入影子 Editor 的 SelectionModel，编辑器同时以 TextEditor 身份暴露，Qoder、Pi 等依赖 IDE 选区的 AI 插件与 Search Everywhere 可读取选中文本（跨行选中不预填）。
  • Ctrl+F now uses the IDE's native find bar with match count, case / whole-word / regex filters, F3 and Shift+F3 navigation, and scrolls the current match into view.
    Ctrl+F 改用 IDE 内置查找栏：复用平台的 SearchReplaceComponent，保留命中计数、大小写/全词/正则过滤与 F3 / Shift+F3 导航，当前命中项自动滚动到视口中央。
  • Ctrl+G jumps to a Markdown source line, with validation against the document line count.
    Ctrl+G 按 Markdown 源码行号跳转，行号范围与文档行数一致，越界时提示合法范围。
  • Removed the reflection-based private hook into the Pi plugin; the selection context now flows through the standard SelectionEvent path.
    移除对 Pi 插件私有接口的反射调用，改由标准 SelectionEvent 通路获取选中上下文。

0.1.0

First stable release with Muya WYSIWYG editing, Markdown structure view, image preview, source line numbers, per-file scroll position memory, and configurable editor background.
首个正式版本：Muya 所见即所得编辑、Markdown 结构视图、图片预览、源码行号、按文件记忆滚动位置、可配置背景色/背景图。
